title: Fail closed for indexed Exists probes outside scanner authority
outcome: F# Exists never proves absence for excluded, skipped, linked, non-regular, unavailable, or otherwise unindexed workspace inputs.
acceptance: An existing indexable-kind file under an excluded directory cannot select a successful !Exists branch.
Missing non-import indexed paths remain unknown unless absence is provable from pinned index evidence.

completion.summary: Generic indexed Exists now returns only true or unknown; excluded/skipped/missing inputs fail closed, with decisive indexed regression coverage and same-session dual-review verification.
